title: Saved counter digits
statement: Let $w$ be a Boolean word and $q$ a natural number. If the binary value of $w$ is $2^{|w|}-1$ and $q+1<2^{|w|}$, then complementing each bit of the word obtained by applying the fixed-width decrement operation $q+1$ times to $w$ gives the width-$|w|$ binary digit list of $q+1$.
